inventive_nucleus: A thin, optically transparent, and mechanically robust polymer film is covalently bonded to the pulse oximeter's sensor to protect it from damage and reduce the effects of low perfusion conditions.
structure: The pulse oximeter sensor is mounted on a printed circuit board (PCB) with the polymer film attached to the sensor using a strong adhesive.
control_logic: step1: The pulse oximeter is powered on and the sensor is initialized.
step2: The sensor is calibrated using a standard calibration algorithm.
interaction: The pulse oximeter continuously monitors the PPG signal and adjusts its calibration parameters in real-time to account for changes in perfusion conditions.
operating_condition: The pulse oximeter is operating in a low perfusion condition.
failure_containment: The polymer film helps to maintain the sensor's structural integrity and reduce the impact of low perfusion conditions on the PPG signal.
expected_effect: Improved accuracy of the pulse oximeter under low perfusion conditions.

inventive_nucleus: A machine learning-based algorithm is integrated into the pulse oximeter's firmware to continuously monitor the PPG signal and adjust the calibration parameters in real-time to account for changes in perfusion conditions.
structure: The pulse oximeter's firmware is modified to include a machine learning-based algorithm that continuously monitors the PPG signal and adjusts the calibration parameters.
control_logic: step1: The pulse oximeter is powered on and the sensor is initialized.
step2: The machine learning algorithm is trained on a dataset of PPG signals under different perfusion conditions.
interaction: The machine learning algorithm continuously monitors the PPG signal and adjusts the calibration parameters in real-time to account for changes in perfusion conditions.
operating_condition: The pulse oximeter is operating in a low perfusion condition.
failure_containment: The machine learning algorithm helps to adapt the pulse oximeter's calibration to the changing perfusion conditions.
expected_effect: Improved accuracy of the pulse oximeter under low perfusion conditions.

inventive_nucleus: A thermochromic material is integrated into the pulse oximeter's sensor to adjust its optical properties in response to changes in temperature, allowing it to adapt to low perfusion conditions.
structure: The pulse oximeter sensor is modified to include a thermochromic material that changes its optical properties in response to changes in temperature.
control_logic: step1: The pulse oximeter is powered on and the sensor is initialized.
step2: The temperature sensor measures the temperature of the sensor.
interaction: The thermochromic material adjusts the sensor's optical properties in response to changes in temperature, allowing it to adapt to low perfusion conditions.
operating_condition: The pulse oximeter is operating in a low perfusion condition.
failure_containment: The thermochromic material helps to adjust the sensor's optical properties to compensate for the reduced signal-to-noise ratio under low perfusion conditions.
expected_effect: Improved accuracy of the pulse oximeter under low perfusion conditions.
